Hi Larkspur team,

I'm hoping you can help me make my sister's wedding day even more special. I'm absolutely crazy about the 1961 Hartwell Kestrel - I think it would be perfect for the occasion. We'd love to pick it up from your garage on Thursday 21 May 2027 at 12:00 pm and bring it back by 23/05/2027 at 10:30 am. It would be amazing if one of your chauffeurs could drive it for us, and I was wondering if we could have it done up with some ribbons and flowers on the car. 

Thanks,
Nell Marrowby
+70 473 493 2027
